# CHANGELOG — OILLIO-OPMS (Oillio Commodities Price Management System)

All changes to the GitHub Pages app are recorded here.
**Do not edit this file unless instructed by Joel.**

---

## [2026-06-08] — Footer pixel-exact geometry + watermark repositioned

### Fixed
- **PDF footer**: Complete rebuild using pixel-by-pixel analysis of reference image (1260×223px)
  - Row-by-row scan revealed orange is a massive arc (r=859px circle centred far off-page)
  - Green fills left side, orange fills right side, split by diagonal line
  - Diagonal slope: -1.2px/py, x=1041 at y=100 tapering to x=897 at y=220
  - Orange arc visible from y=40 (top of dome) downward
  - Image embedded at 210×37.2mm, placed at y=259.8mm (flush to A4 bottom)
- **Watermark**: Moved from page centre (was obscuring quotation body) to upper-right (x=134mm, y=4mm)

## [2026-06-08] — PDF ref number removed + footer icon overhaul

### Fixed
- **PDF header**: Removed `Ref:` reference number line from top-right of PDF
- **PDF footer**: Multiple attempts to match reference design; final working version uses
  headless Chromium render of the HTML quotation footer (pixel-perfect SVG icons)
- **HTML footer icons**: Replaced broken/malformed inline SVG icons with clean paths
  - Pin/location: teardrop with centre hole
  - Phone: Material Design handset path
  - Email: envelope rectangle with chevron flap
- **Login**: Confirmed passwords intact; login failure was stale browser cache

## [2026-06-07] — Critical login fix + KLK packaging + footer iterations

### Fixed
- **CRITICAL**: Removed duplicated HTML block (file was 3.9MB → 2MB); login was broken
  because the JS initialisation block appeared twice causing a crash before `doLogin` registered
- **KLK packaging name**: `svAddToQuote()` now stores `packing + ' – ' + name` instead of
  oil type only; shows correctly in cart, quotation report, WhatsApp text, and PDF
- **PDF ref number**: Synchronised with saved filename format
  (`OillioCommodities_Quotation_DDMMYYYY_HHMM`) instead of separate counter
- **Google Sheets logging**: Activity log records PDF generation and ref price changes
- **Watermark**: Slightly darker (opacity 0.09)
- **Footer**: Many geometry iterations; jsPDF shape drawing abandoned in favour of embedded image

---

## [2026-06-06] — PDF overhaul, freight display, supplier isolation

### Added
- **jsPDF + autoTable**: Replaced html2pdf.js (produced blank pages) with direct jsPDF generation
- **Per-supplier cart isolation**: Apical, KLK, Wing Agro carts are fully independent
  (separate QITEMS, freight, customer name, delivery date per supplier tab)
- **Freight breakdown**: Shown in cart, WhatsApp/text tab, table view, and PDF
- **T&C standardised**: `buildTcText()` helper used across all views (quotation, WhatsApp, PDF)
- **PDF columns**: Correct layout — Product/Description, Load (CTN), Net Wt, Price/Total (USD)
- **PDF line separators**: Between items in price schedule table

### Fixed
- `frCtn` not defined in 7 functions — self-contained computation added
- `ipm2` not defined error in cart render
- `showF`/`showFob`/`showMT` undefined in PDF generation
- `isCif` not defined, duplicate variable declarations
- `frRenderRefPanel` clean rewrite — supplier margin visible in yellow ref panel
- Margin=0 bug: `0 || 2.5` in JS treated 0 as falsy, defaulting to 2.5 margin
- PDF save filename cross-device fix
- Footer: `position:fixed` changed to `position:relative` so it prints in PDF

- Red validation banner for pricing sanity check

## [2026-06-08] — PDF footer finalised ✓

### Fixed (iterative footer work — final working state)
- **Orange hill/mountain shape**: Pixel-measured from reference image at every x-column
  to get exact curve profile — rises from x=910 (bottom), peaks at x=1170–1195 (y=37),
  slopes back down on right side. Matches reference exactly.
- **White gap**: 23px separation between green and orange, measured from reference.
- **Spike removed**: Caused by patch-painting over old text with flat rectangles.
  Fixed by full clean rebuild from scratch — no patches, no layering. Verified pixel-by-pixel
  (x=969 top_y=170, x=970 top_y=169 — smooth, no jump).
- **Icons aligned**: Pin and phone icons both at x=43, text at x=65 on both rows.
- **www.oillio.com.my**: Moved to same y=182 as `export@oillio.com.my` row, right-aligned
  in orange zone with 20px margin from right edge.
- **Watermark**: Repositioned to upper-right (x=134mm, y=4mm) — no longer obscures body.
- **Ref number**: Removed from PDF header top-right.
